questions.standard_level: Algebra II. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Algebra II, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.response: write the answer and show the required work
questions.prompt: Show that (a + b)² - (a - b)² = 4ab for all numbers a and b.
questions.prompt_markup: Show that (a + b)² - (a - b)² = 4ab for all numbers a and b.
questions.required_method: Expand both squares: (a² + 2ab + b²) - (a² - 2ab + b²) = 4ab. The steps must be shown.
questions.grading_note: Any correct algebraic proof is accepted; checking numbers alone is not a proof.
